integrity: Complete, exact 2048-state exhaustive classification. Two different self-contained enumeration programs have been run and compared. Their scripts are provided; no external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the 11-vertex graph mu(C5), binary synchronous open-neighbor majority with ties retained, and the specified labelled convention; no assertion about higher Mycielski graphs or stochastic models. The novelty comparison cannot exclude all unindexed historical computations.
title: Majority attraction basins and a sharp seven-update clock on the Grötzsch graph
